fact: The Eighth National Development Plan 2022-2026 states that the civil and vital registration system will be decentralised to increase coverage of the registration of vital events, including operationalisation of the Integrated National Registration Information System (INRIS), lists INRIS as a programme, and lists civil registration and vital statistics automation as a health-sector programme.
title: Eighth National Development Plan (8NDP) 2022-2026: Socio-economic transformation for improved livelihoods
publisher: Ministry of Finance and National Planning
